title: MV Using Live2D Cubism to make Frontview Enemies

posts.author: ValentinaSama67
posts.body:
Hey everyone, I had this idea in mind for a while now, and I wanted to discuss if it's even a possibility using RMMV.
I know that RPG Maker MV already has a dragonbones integration plugin that allows for DragonBones animations instead of the common spritesheet battlers. But is there already a plugin that allows for compatibilty with live2D cubism? If there isn't, how much do you think it would cost to commission such plugin?
My main objective with using Live2D for battlers is that it would be much quicker to animate using cubism than animating frame by frame, since it would require drawing every animation for every enemy instead of just cutting the drawing up and using the editor to make animations. But what do you guys think? Is there maybe another alternative that isn't too time consuming to make enemy sprites?
What are your thoughts?
I'd love to discuss this further.
